meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 一键转为微信公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需将 Markdown 快速排版为微信文章格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account article format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly format Markdown as WeChat articles

howto.what: 装上后,你把 Markdown 文稿交给 Claude,它会用配套命令行工具把它转成微信公众号的 HTML,并先做格式检查和预览。它还支持生成封面或信息图、提供标题建议、改写文字风格等,只有你明确要求时才会上传草稿或发布。
howto.when: 当你说出“排版”“预览”“上传草稿”这类关键词,或要求生成封面图、标题建议等其他公众号操作时,该技能会触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 转成公众号文章并预览
say.note: 会先检查再转换,不自动上传

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图
say.note: 生成封面图或返回制作提示

say.text: 为这篇文章建议几个公众号标题
say.note: 只给标题候选,不会自动发布

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML using a CLI, run checks and previews, generate covers or title suggestions, and upload drafts only when you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for WeChat article formatting, preview, or draft upload, and for related tasks such as cover generation or title suggestions.

say_en.text: Turn this Markdown into a WeChat article and preview it
say_en.note: It will check first, then convert; no automatic upload.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article
say_en.note: It either produces a cover or returns a creation prompt.

say_en.text: Suggest some WeChat titles for this article
say_en.note: Returns candidates only; nothing is published.
